# odyssey-097 — new renderings chosen (19.503–604)

Format: Greek · line · `l` / `i` · what was refused · why.

## Noun–epithet pairs and epithets likely to recur

- **χλωρηῒς ἀηδών** (518, with Πανδαρέου κούρη) · `l` "the green nightingale" / `i` "the green nightingale" · refused "the green-hued nightingale" and "the nightingale of the green leaves" (each picks one reading) · χλωρηΐς is fem. adj. of χλωρός "green"; colour of the bird or her leafy haunt is disputed, so plain "green"; note says so. Πανδαρέου κούρη is "Pandareus' daughter" / "the daughter of Pandareus".
- **ἀδινὸν κῆρ** (516) · "thronging heart" / "thronging heart" · refused "heavy heart", "throbbing heart" · extends the table's μῆλ’ ἁδινά "thronging sheep"; ἀδινός = close-packed, here the heart crowded with cares.
- **μελιηδὴς ὕπνος** (551) · "honey-sweet sleep" / "honey-sweet sleep" · refused "sweet sleep" (kept for γλυκερὸς ὕπνος 511 and ἡδὺς ὕπνος 604, shipped) · extends the table's μελιηδὴς οἶνος "honey-sweet wine".
- **αἰετὸς ἀγκυλοχείλης** (538) · "a great eagle, hook-beaked" / "hook-beaked" · refused "crook-beaked", "curved-lipped" · ἀγκύλος "curved" + χεῖλος "lip, beak".
- **ἀμενηνὰ ὄνειρα** (ἀμενηνῶν ὀνείρων, 562) · "powerless dreams" / "powerless dreams" · refused "feeble" (reserved for ἄκικυς) · follows the table's ἀμενηνὰ κάρηνα "powerless heads".
- **ἀκριτόμυθοι** (560, of dreams) · "indistinct-of-speech" / "indistinct in what they say" · refused "of confused speech", "babbling" · ἄκριτος "not sorted out" + μῦθος.
- **ἀμήχανοι** (560, of dreams) · `l` "helpless" / `i` "helpless" · REVIEW RULING: `i` "baffling" withdrawn; the table's "helpless" (19.363 row) stands in both layers, and the note says that of dreams it means that one has no way to handle them.
- **δυσώνυμος ἠώς** (571) · "ill-named" / "an ill-named dawn" · refused "ill-omened", "of evil name" in `i` as the rendering · literal δυσ- + ὄνομα.
- **ζείδωρος ἄρουρα** (593) · "the grain-giving plough-land" / same · applies the existing 3.3 row.
- **νήπιος** (530, of the boy Telemachus) · "child" / "a child" · refused "infant" (table, for a baby), "foolish" (table, for adults) · third sense of the word, a young person.
- **χαλίφρων** (530) · "light-minded" / "thoughtless" · "-minded" in `l` follows the -φρων epithets.
- **ἀπερείσια ἕδνα** (529) · "unstinted bridal gifts" / "unstinted bridal gifts" · REVIEW CHANGE from "immense" (reserved for ἀθέσφατος); refused "boundless" (ἀπείρων, ἄσπετα), "immense", "measureless" (ἀπέλεθρος), "limitless" (ἀπείριτος), "countless" and "numberless" (μυρία), "endless" and "unlimited" (turned down for ἀπείρων and ἄσπετα) · ἕδνα "bridal gifts" follows the table's μυρία ἕδνα.
- **ἀμέτρητον πένθος** (512) · "grief immeasurable" / "grief past all measure" · ἀμέτρητος from μετρέω.
- **κουρίδιον δῶμα** (580) · "wedded" / "house of my marriage" · follows the table's κουρίδιῳ πόσει "wedded husband".
- **δρυόχοι** (574, δρυόχους ὥς) · "ship-props" / "ship-props" (note: meaning uncertain; traditional gloss) · refused "oak-holders", transliteration.
- **ὕπαρ** against **ὄναρ** (547) · "waking sight" · "dream" · ὕπαρ is a thing seen awake.
- **πριστὸς ἐλέφας** (564) · "sawn ivory" · **ξεστὰ κέρα** (566) · "polished horn" · the gates of dreams; ξεστός follows ξέω "polish" in the table's δίφρον ἐύξοον.
- **μοῖρα** (singular, 592) · "a portion" · refused "fate" (reserved), "lot" · extends the table's plural μοῖρα "portions".
- **θνητοῖσιν** (593) · "mortal men" · refused "mortals" (reserved for βροτοί).
- **αἰνὸν ὄνειρον** (568) · "fearsome dream" · applies the table's αἰνός "fearsome".

## Whole-line formulas

- **ὣς εἰποῦσ’ ἀνέβαιν’ ὑπερώϊα σιγαλόεντα** (600) · "So having spoken she went up to the glossy upper rooms," / "So she spoke, and went up to her glossy upper rooms," · built from the table's ὣς εἰπών, ὑπερώϊα "upper rooms" and σιγαλόεις "glossy".
- **ἐγὼ δέ τοι αἰετὸς ὄρνις / ἦα πάρος, νῦν αὖτε τεὸς πόσις εἰλήλουθα** (548–549) · l "and I, for you, an eagle, a bird, was before, but now again your husband have come" · eagle-dream identification, unlikely to recur.
- **ἔπος … ἔν περ ὀνείρῳ** (541, 581) · "even in a dream" in both lines, kept identical.
- **ἐφήσω** (550, 576) · `l` "will lay"/"shall lay" both times, `i` "bring … on" for the doom and "set" for the contest.

## Deviation from a packet-shown repeat

- 19.558 (`πᾶσι μάλ’, οὐδέ κέ τις θάνατον καὶ κῆρας ἀλύξει`): REVIEW RULING: strict identity with the shipped English of odyssey-087 ("nor would any escape" / "no one would escape"); the drafter's "will" is withdrawn in both layers.
